rendered.title: Free 4-Month Sleep Regression Masterclass
rendered.meta_description: Is your 3–4 month-old suddenly waking every hour? Sign up for Sally Woods’ free 20-minute masterclass and learn gentle, evidence-based steps to dodge the 4-month regression and set up 12-hour nights—plus get a limited-time discount on the 3-4 Month Sleep Course.
